In Stat230, you can [spend a token](https://forms.gle/MivjnJEbqHesQYnw9) to retake a quiz or resubmit a case study (or have an extension). Both should be done individually. 

# Quiz Retakes

- To retake a quiz, you must spend a token
- If you retake a quiz, you can earn up to 25% of your missed points back

To retake a quiz

- Fill out the [spend a token](https://forms.gle/MivjnJEbqHesQYnw9) form
- Fill out the retake cover sheet (linked on moodle)
- Review *all* questions and concepts, even those you earned full points on
- The retake is a 30 minute "second pass" at the content from the quiz. The questions will be different but cover the same concepts.
- Retakes should be scheduled with me during an office hour or at an alternative time during the regular workday.
    - Please schedule with me at least a week out! 
- Retakes must be completed before the next quiz. 

**For quiz01 only:** The content of quiz01 will continue to be used throughout MLR, so quiz02 is kind of an extension of the ideas of quiz01. If your score on quiz02 is *higher* than your score on quiz01 (before retakes), I will replace your quiz01 score with quiz02. You do not need to spend a token to use this option; I will do it for everybody. 

# Case Study Revisions

- For an extension on the original submission of the case study, **all** group members must spend a token
- For a revision on the case study, submit a token and complete the revision **individually**.
    - If you do not sufficiently contribute to the original submission of a case study, you may not revise that case study. You may instead complete an individual case study on the option that you did not do on the original submission. 
- Case study revisions must be submitted within a week of when feedback is returned to you. 
- If you submit a case study revision, you can earn up to 50% of your missed points back

To submit a revision:  

- Fill out the [spend a token](https://forms.gle/MivjnJEbqHesQYnw9) form
- Follow the same guidelines as the original case study, including submitting a separate quarto appendix to me 
- In addition, you should write a 1 paragraph summary of the main changes that you made. This can be a paragraph at the beginning or end of your report and does not count towards the page limit 
- There will be a separate submission space on gradescope for case study revisions
- I **may** ask you to schedule a 5-10 minute meeting to discuss the case study with me in more detail. For this conversation, you should be prepared to discuss the data context, modeling choices, and conclusions that are made in your report.
